figure_description: Four rays share a common vertex O. In counterclockwise order around vertex O: ray OP extends horizontally to the right; ray OQ extends upward and to the right into the first quadrant; ray OR extends steeply upward and slightly to the left; and ray OS extends upward and to the left into the second quadrant.
